stemEn: A child with spinal muscular atrophy and lobar pneumonia is hypoxemic on room air; venous pCO2 is elevated. What mechanism best explains the hypoxemia in the recalled question?
scenarioAr: طفل SMA مع pneumonia وhypoxemia وelevated pCO2.
explanationAr: المصدر يختار hypoventilation استنادًا إلى elevated pCO2، مع بقاء الصورة السريرية المركبة بحاجة إلى تحقق مستقل.
incorrectOptionsAr: التمييز عن V/Q mismatch يحتاج تقييمًا فسيولوجيًا كاملًا؛ لم يُعتمد المفتاح كتحقق مستقل.
clinicalPearl: Keep the recalled physiologic answer separate from verification.

tts.text: A child with spinal muscular atrophy and lobar pneumonia is hypoxemic on room air; venous pCO2 is elevated. What mechanism best explains the hypoxemia? Option A. Hypoventilation. Option B. V/Q mismatch. Option C. Intra-alveolar dead space.

stemEn: A child with SMA has severe respiratory distress and persistent desaturation despite high-flow oxygen. Chest radiography shows right upper-lobe collapse or pneumonia. What is the next respiratory support?
scenarioAr: طفل SMA شديد الضيق التنفسي مع desaturation رغم high-flow oxygen وصورة صدر فيها collapse/pneumonia.
explanationAr: المصدر يميل إلى trial of NIV إذا كان الطفل hemodynamically stable ولا توجد contraindications، لكنه يذكر أن الحاجة الفورية لحماية airway أو altered mental status تستلزم intubation. لذلك الإجابة غير محسومة دون تفاصيل إضافية.
incorrectOptionsAr: Mechanical ventilation قد يصبح الصحيح إذا وُجدت contraindications للـNIV أو need for immediate airway protection.
clinicalPearl: This source item is conditional rather than absolute.

tts.text: A child with SMA has severe respiratory distress and persistent desaturation despite high-flow oxygen. Chest radiography shows right upper-lobe collapse or pneumonia. What is the next respiratory support? Option A. Noninvasive ventilation. Option B. Mechanical ventilation.

stemEn: An infant with bronchiolitis has right upper-lobe collapse on chest radiograph and remains around 90% saturation on high-flow oxygen. What is the next step?
scenarioAr: Bronchiolitis مع persistent desaturation وصورة صدر فيها right upper-lobe collapse.
explanationAr: مفتاح المصدر NIV باعتبار أن severe distress قد يحتاج advanced respiratory support عندما لا يكفي oxygen وحده.
incorrectOptionsAr: المصدر لا يدعم الخيارات الدوائية الأخرى كخطوة تالية في هذا السيناريو.
clinicalPearl: Image and severity details must be reviewed before publication.

tts.text: An infant with bronchiolitis has right upper-lobe collapse on chest radiograph and remains around 90% saturation on high-flow oxygen. What is the next step? Option A. Start noninvasive ventilation. Option B. High-dose dexamethasone. Option C. Salbutamol nebulization. Option D. Racemic epinephrine.

stemEn: A child with cough, dyspnea, night sweats, distended neck veins and facial congestion has an anterior mediastinal mass. What is the major concern when sedating the child for CT imaging?
scenarioAr: Anterior mediastinal mass مع respiratory and SVC-type symptoms، والسؤال عن خطر sedation للـCT.
explanationAr: المصدر يركز على خطر airway collapse أثناء sedation بسبب فقدان upper-airway tone وانخفاض lung volumes مع external compression من mediastinal mass.
incorrectOptionsAr: الخطر المحوري في شرح المصدر هو airway compromise، مع أن hemodynamic compression قد يكون مهمًا سريريًا أيضًا.
clinicalPearl: Sedation can precipitate catastrophic airway obstruction in an anterior mediastinal mass.

Option A. Age. Option B. Chest infection. Option C. Hemodynamic instability. Option D. Airway compromise.

stemEn: A fully conscious child with severe asthma remains hypoxemic despite bronchodilators and high-concentration oxygen. What is the next step?
scenarioAr: Severe asthma مع persistent hypoxemia رغم العلاج، والطفل fully conscious.
explanationAr: مفتاح المصدر NIV في المريض الواعي دون دلائل على فشل حماية airway؛ لكن يلزم مراقبة الاستجابة والاستعداد للتصعيد.
incorrectOptionsAr: Intubation يُحجز عادةً عند deterioration أو altered mental status أو failure of noninvasive support وفق السياق.
clinicalPearl: Escalate support while avoiding premature intubation when NIV is appropriate.

tts.text: A fully conscious child with severe asthma remains hypoxemic despite bronchodilators and high-concentration oxygen. What is the next step? Option A. Initiate noninvasive ventilation. Option B. Intubate.

stemEn: A child with severe asthma has received systemic steroid, magnesium, continuous albuterol and IV terbutaline but develops altered mental status, minimal air entry and marked hypercapnia. What is the next step?
scenarioAr: Status asthmaticus فشل maximal therapy مع altered mental status وminimal air entry وhypercapnia.
explanationAr: وجود altered mental status مع فشل maximal therapy وارتفاع CO2 يدعم intubation حسب شرح المصدر.
incorrectOptionsAr: زيادة bronchodilator أو إضافة adjunct وحدها لا تكفي عند impending respiratory failure في سيناريو المصدر.
clinicalPearl: Altered mental status plus worsening ventilation is a major escalation signal.

tts.text: A child with severe asthma has received systemic steroid, magnesium, continuous albuterol and IV terbutaline but develops altered mental status, minimal air entry and marked hypercapnia. What is the next step? Option A. Increase albuterol. Option B. Give ipratropium. Option C. Heliox. Option D. Intubate.

stemEn: Which induction agent is recalled as preferred during rapid-sequence intubation of a child with severe asthma?
scenarioAr: سؤال عن induction agent في RSI لمريض severe asthma.
explanationAr: المصدر يختار ketamine ويذكر خصائصه المفيدة في asthmatic RSI.
clinicalPearl: Verify dosing and current RSI practice separately from the recalled key.

tts.text: Which induction agent is recalled as preferred during rapid-sequence intubation of a child with severe asthma? Option A. Ketamine.

subtopic: Medication to avoid in asthma intubation
stemEn: Which medication should be avoided when intubating a child with asthma because of histamine release?
scenarioAr: سؤال pharmacology في intubation لمريض asthma.
explanationAr: المصدر يختار morphine بسبب histamine-releasing properties؛ synthetic opioids مثل fentanyl أقل تسببًا بذلك.
incorrectOptionsAr: المصدر لا يحدد بقية الخيارات كأدوية يجب تجنبها لهذا السبب.
clinicalPearl: Histamine release is the source's key distinction.

tts.text: Which medication should be avoided when intubating a child with asthma because of histamine release? Option A. Ketamine. Option B. Fentanyl. Option C. Morphine. Option D. Succinylcholine.

stemEn: A normotensive child with traumatic brain injury has shallow breathing and needs rapid-sequence intubation. Which recalled drug combination is preferred among the listed choices?
scenarioAr: TBI مع الحاجة إلى RSI، والمريض normotensive.
explanationAr: المصدر يختار thiopental-based option بين الخيارات، لكنه يوضح أن modern practice often favors etomidate and that ketamine is no longer absolutely contraindicated in TBI. لذلك يحتاج تحديث مرجعي.
incorrectOptionsAr: المصدر نفسه يذكر أن بعض rationale القديمة حول ketamine تغيّرت؛ لذلك لا نعتمد الخيارات دون مراجعة حديثة.
clinicalPearl: Historical RSI teaching may be outdated; keep the source answer but flag it.

stemEn: A child with high-energy road-traffic trauma and a femur fracture requires RSI. Which drug combination was recalled as the answer?
scenarioAr: Major trauma يحتاج RSI؛ السؤال عن drug combination.
explanationAr: مفتاح المصدر etomidate + succinylcholine + fentanyl، مع ضرورة التحقق من بروتوكول RSI الحديث والسياق hemodynamic.
incorrectOptionsAr: الاختيار النهائي في الواقع يعتمد على hemodynamics وcontraindications؛ الاسترجاع محدود.
clinicalPearl: Do not generalize a recalled RSI combination beyond the source context.

tts.text: A child with high-energy road-traffic trauma and a femur fracture requires RSI. Which drug combination was recalled as the answer? Option A. Etomidate, succinylcholine, fentanyl. Option B. Thiopental, succinylcholine, fentanyl. Option C. Ketamine-based regimen.

stemEn: What uncuffed endotracheal tube internal diameter is recalled for a 4-year-old child?
scenarioAr: سؤال مباشر عن uncuffed ETT size لعمر 4 سنوات.
explanationAr: المصدر يختار 5 mm. يُراجع مع معادلات ETT size الحديثة قبل الاعتماد.
incorrectOptionsAr: 7 و8 mm أكبر من المفتاح المسترجع، لكن الاعتماد النهائي ينتظر التحقق.
clinicalPearl: Tube-size formulas should be independently verified before publishing an exam rule.

stemEn: A preterm newborn with severe respiratory distress is intubated and placed on mechanical ventilation. What is the next investigation after tube placement?
scenarioAr: Preterm newborn بعد intubation والاتصال بالventilator؛ السؤال عن التحقيق التالي.
explanationAr: المصدر يختار chest radiograph لتوثيق tube position وتقييم الرئتين بعد تأكيد أولي لوضع الأنبوب.
incorrectOptionsAr: RBS وABG قد يكونان مهمين في السياق، لكنهما ليسا المفتاح المسترجع للسؤال.
clinicalPearl: Radiography documents depth after immediate bedside confirmation.

stemEn: An intubated patient suddenly desaturates. Chest radiography shows unilateral white-out on the left and hyperinflation on the right, consistent with a deeply advanced ETT and no pneumothorax. What is the next step?
scenarioAr: Sudden desaturation بعد intubation مع CXR توحي deep ETT.
explanationAr: مفتاح المصدر pull back/withdraw the ETT. يربط الشرح ذلك بمبدأ DOPE عند sudden deterioration after intubation.
incorrectOptionsAr: Chest tube لا يطابق غياب pneumothorax؛ زيادة PEEP/HFOV لا تعالج malposition للأنبوب.
clinicalPearl: Always check displacement/obstruction/pneumothorax/equipment in sudden ventilator deterioration.

image.captionEn: Original radiograph demonstrating deep ETT required.

Chest radiography shows unilateral white-out on the left and hyperinflation on the right, consistent with a deeply advanced ETT and no pneumothorax. What is the next step? Option A. Withdraw the ETT. Option B. Insert a chest tube. Option C. Increase PEEP. Option D. Switch to HFOV.

stemEn: A ventilated 3-year-old suddenly becomes hypotensive and tachycardic with absent breath sounds on one side. What is the immediate next step?
scenarioAr: Ventilated child مع shock وunilateral absent breath sounds، ما يوحي tension pneumothorax.
explanationAr: المصدر يختار immediate needle decompression للحالة المشتبهة tension pneumothorax، يليها definitive chest tube.
incorrectOptionsAr: Chest tube definitive لكنه يأتي بعد emergency decompression في السيناريو غير المستقر؛ bagging لا يزيل tension.
clinicalPearl: Treat suspected tension pneumothorax immediately when unstable.

stemEn: A 2-year-old on SIMV volume control remains severely hypoxemic despite FiO2 100%; PEEP is 5 cm H2O, tidal volume and blood gas ventilation are acceptable. What adjustment best improves oxygenation?
scenarioAr: Ventilated child مع refractory hypoxemia رغم FiO2 100% وPEEP منخفض نسبيًا، بينما ventilation مقبولة.
explanationAr: المصدر يختار زيادة PEEP؛ oxygenation تتأثر أساسًا بـFiO2 وPEEP وmean airway pressure بينما RR يعالج ventilation أكثر.
incorrectOptionsAr: رفع RR أو Vt يستهدف minute ventilation أكثر، والتحويل للpressure control ليس المفتاح المسترجع.
clinicalPearl: Separate oxygenation controls from ventilation controls.

stemEn: A child with cerebral palsy and aspiration pneumonia has chronic parenchymal lung changes on chest radiograph. Which ventilatory strategy is preferred in the recalled question?

options.text: Low tidal volume with adequate PEEP
High tidal volume with adequate PEEP
Usual tidal volume with usual PEEP
Usual tidal volume with high PEEP

scenarioAr: CP child مع aspiration pneumonia وchronic parenchymal changes على CXR.
explanationAr: المصدر يختار low tidal volume مع مناسب/مرتفع PEEP كـlung-protective strategy في parenchymal disease مع hypoxemia.
incorrectOptionsAr: High tidal volume قد يزيد ventilator-induced lung injury؛ بقية الخيارات تحتاج تحقق حسب severity.
clinicalPearl: Parenchymal hypoxemic failure favors lung-protective ventilation.

stemEn: A child with respiratory failure requires high ventilator settings yet remains markedly hypoxemic; chest radiography is described as showing ARDS changes. What is the most likely diagnosis?
scenarioAr: Respiratory failure مع high ventilator settings وpersistent hypoxemia وصورة موصوفة كـARDS.
explanationAr: مفتاح المصدر ARDS. السؤال يعتمد على صورة الصدر ووصفها، لذلك الصورة الأصلية مطلوبة قبل النشر.
incorrectOptionsAr: المصدر يرجح ARDS من النمط الموصوف، لكن الصورة والفحص الكامل مطلوبان للتفريق.
clinicalPearl: Do not publish image-based ARDS identification without the original image.

stemEn: A 13-year-old recovering from prolonged severe ARDS needs assessment of respiratory impairment after discharge. Which test is most useful?
scenarioAr: مراهق بعد severe ARDS مطول؛ المطلوب test لتقييم respiratory status بعد discharge.
explanationAr: المصدر يختار spirometry/PFTs لتقييم objective respiratory impairment ومتابعة المسار بعد المرض.
incorrectOptionsAr: Methacholine مخصص أكثر للairway hyperresponsiveness، والصور لا تقيس الوظيفة الرئوية مباشرة مثل spirometry.
clinicalPearl: Functional assessment is distinct from anatomic imaging.

tts.text: A 13-year-old recovering from prolonged severe ARDS needs assessment of respiratory impairment after discharge. Which test is most useful? Option A. Spirometry. Option B. Methacholine challenge. Option C. Chest radiograph. Option D. Chest CT.

stemEn: After general anesthesia with succinylcholine, a child develops marked rigidity and a temperature around 40°C. What is the most likely diagnosis?
scenarioAr: بعد general anesthesia وsuccinylcholine ظهر rigidity وsevere hyperthermia.
explanationAr: المصدر يختار malignant hyperthermia، وهي hypermetabolic crisis مرتبطة بالتعرض لـsuccinylcholine أو volatile anesthetics في الأشخاص القابلين.
clinicalPearl: The recalled diagnosis is classic, but emergency management should be separately verified before publication.

tts.text: After general anesthesia with succinylcholine, a child develops marked rigidity and a temperature around 40 degrees Celsius. What is the most likely diagnosis? Option A. Malignant hyperthermia.
